room_description: A vibrant, futuristic lounge with a bright blue and green galaxy-patterned wall. It contains modern black and white curved seating, a suspended spherical fireplace, colorful hanging light bulbs, and abstract art pieces.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the futuristic lounge.
Finding a red utility knife hidden under a sofa pillow.
Collecting a U-shaped magnet from the white futuristic chair.
Using the magnet on a string to fish a white sphere out of a tall vase.
Opening the white cabinet to find an empty glass.
Arranging the four colored square blocks on the wall panel.
Viewing the planets/spheres through the telescope.
Entering '4681' into the colored button panel.
Collecting a purple screwdriver from the opened compartment.
Removing the panel on the white table using the screwdriver to get the final key.

solution_steps: Find the magnet on the white chair.
Attach the magnet to the string hanging over the tall white vase.
Lower it to pull out the white sphere with the number '6' on it.
Observe the colored squares hidden around the room (e.g., behind pillows, on walls).
Rearrange the sliders so the colors match the sequence: Grey, Red, Grey, Green.
Look through the telescope at the starry background.
Identify the numbers written on the floating colored planets: Pink(4), Yellow(6), Green(8), Yellow-Green(1).
Note the sequence based on the colored bulbs hanging in the room.
Input the code '4681' into the lock matching the planet colors.
Take the purple screwdriver from the compartment.
Use the screwdriver to remove the side panel from the futuristic white table.

final_action: The player takes the key revealed inside the white table structure and uses it to unlock the modern glass door to escape.
